department: Biomedical and Translational Sciences, Sanford School of Medicine

deadline.value: Fall deadline for the Ph.D. is April 1 (year inferred), with decisions by May 15.
deadline.quote: April 1st (Ph.D.) decisions are made by May 15th

app_fee.value: The Biomedical and Translational Sciences catalog entry lists a $40 non-refundable application fee.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Admission is not tied to a named mentor; students choose a faculty mentor during the second year.
supervisor.quote: finalize the selection of a faculty mentor to oversee their laboratory research

funding.value: Admitted research-track students are eligible for a fellowship stipend, but the page does not say most or all PhD students are funded.

entry_route.value: Applicants need a baccalaureate degree from an accredited institution.
entry_route.quote: Applicants must have a baccalaureate degree from an institution with institutional accreditation for that degree

notes: Basic biomedical and translational sciences Ph.D. (the Basic Biomedical Science program on the STEM list).
